name: Argonne MI250 vLLM Mistral-7B b64
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench arXiv:2411.00136). vLLM, FP16/BF16, 128in/128out. throughput=batch*(in+out)/e2e latency = AGGREGATE over batch. 1 tile bs64. CSV 'AMD MI250 GPU' = ALCF Polaris MI250 (2-tile GCD card, 128GB HBM2e). N= number of tiles/cards used.
